raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash needs a resumable forward to interleave long prefills with decode. Intermediate slices retain batch-owned mHC, Engram and tail state; only the final slice computes logits.

## Changes

- Reuse the ordinary mHC loop and retain combined/normalized carry across layer intervals. Prepare multimodal inputs once.
- Match the [pdmux-standard layer_split reference](https://github.com/Li-brua/sglang/tree/17761860ccbc6cea53b0c3625fa0c89880b48f9e): select streams from the local running decode batch, gather decode metadata after stream selection, budget layers from the maximum DP token count and use no additional layer-count cap.
- Switch only the full-TP communicator in the prefill scope and retain the sampler's request-replica group. Support capped-prefill/full-device-decode overlap.
- Preserve chunk stash/filter/abort ordering, release persistent activations at completion and install HiCache consumer fences on every slice.
- Enforce compressor-plan admission limits; protect shared-expert input aliasing, helper streams and shared workspaces for the DeepSeek model path.

Attention DP and speculative decoding remain gated until their dependent adapters. Shared runtime work overlaps [GLM core PDMux #42411](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42411).

## Stack and validation

First layer of [the rollout #42515](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42515). Based on `5b5d72123935dc2a3fb341790796ec1a987d31ce`. The integration branch has exactly four feature commits; this head contains the first 1. Each child targets upstream `main`. After predecessors merge, rebase and drop merged dependency commits.

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Cumulative core-prefix CPU regression, 30 test files | 248 passed, 2 skipped, 155 subtests passed |
| Ruff lint/format, isort and diff whitespace | Passed |

Coverage includes split-forward state, token budgets, admission, chunk lifetime, stream selection and ordinary runtime regressions. CPU tensors and runtime imports are real; CUDA kernels, streams and collectives are mocked. GPU collective liveness, output parity, speculative acceptance and performance remain unverified.

[GPU runbook](https://github.com/Li-brua/sglang/blob/feat/dsv41-flash-pdmux-core/test/manual/pdmux/layerwise_prefill_runbook.md).

+"""DSV4-Flash 8-GPU PD-Multiplexing concurrency test (TP8, no spec decoding).
+
+Covers the PDMux-differentiating paths the serial sanity cannot reach:
+
+- P/D true concurrency: a streaming decode request is confirmed running before
+  long prompts are injected, so running_batch and split_prefill_batch are
+  non-empty together and the shared green-context SM groups get selected.
+- Cross-segment split prefill: split_forward_token_budget=8192 with ~4k-token
+  prompts forces the layer-split state (hidden/residual + mHC carries) to
+  survive many segments on real tensors.
+- Dual NCCL communicators in flight + per-call sampler TP-group resolution
+  (SYNC_TOKEN_IDS_ACROSS_TP=1 puts an all-reduce on every decode step and on
+  the split-prefill final sample).
+- Per-SM-group decode graph replay: manual division thresholds spread 1-8
+  concurrent decodes across different shared groups.
+
+Assertion -> path map:
+  (i)   streaming prefix matches serial baseline  -> concurrent prefill does
+        not corrupt decode (SM/KV isolation, communicator ordering)
+  (ii)  needle answers correct per request        -> cross-segment numerics +
+        cross-request KV isolation (unique code per request)
+  (iii) all requests finish within the deadline   -> no dual-communicator or
+        prefill-handshake deadlock
+  (iv)  post-storm sanity answer                  -> finalize merge into a
+        non-empty running batch (GPU-level)
+
+Model path can be overridden for offline containers:
+  SGLANG_TEST_DSV4_FLASH_MODEL_PATH=/model python3 <this file>

+

+import json
+import os
+import tempfile
+import threading
+import unittest
+
+import requests
+
+from sglang.srt.utils import kill_process_tree
+from sglang.test.test_utils import (
+    DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_FOR_SERVER_LAUNCH,
+    DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST,
+    CustomTestCase,
+    popen_launch_server,
+)
+
+DSV4_FLASH_MODEL_PATH = os.environ.get(
+    "SGLANG_TEST_DSV4_FLASH_MODEL_PATH", "sgl-project/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-FP8"
+)
+
+DSV4_FLASH_ENV = {
+    "SGLANG_DEEPEP_NUM_MAX_DISPATCH_TOKENS_PER_RANK": "1024",
+    # Pure-TP (no deepep A2A) resolves the auto MoE runner to Triton, which

+    "SGLANG_DSV4_FP4_DEQUANT": "1",
+    # The sampler reads this unprefixed name (sampler.py SYNC_TOKEN_IDS_ACROSS_TP):
+    # forces a TP all-reduce with per-call group resolution on every decode step
+    # and on the split-prefill final sample.
+    "SYNC_TOKEN_IDS_ACROSS_TP": "1",

+        "What is the secret code mentioned at the beginning? "
+        "Answer with the digits only:"

+                    "max_new_tokens": max_new_tokens,
+                },
+            },
+            timeout=600,

+        # by the sanity test); used for the prefix comparison in (i).
+        baseline_text = self._generate(STREAM_PROMPT, 256)

+        first_token_seen = threading.Event()
+        stream_state = {"text": "", "error": None}
+
+        def stream_worker():
+            try:
+                with requests.post(
+                    f"{self.base_url}/generate",
+                    json={
+                        "text": STREAM_PROMPT,
+                        "sampling_params": {
+                            "temperature": 0,
+                            "max_new_tokens": 256,
+                        },
+                        "stream": True,
+                    },
+                    stream=True,
+                    timeout=600,
+                ) as resp:
+                    resp.raise_for_status()
+                    for line in resp.iter_lines():
+                        if not line:
+                            continue
+                        line = line.decode()
+                        if not line.startswith("data:"):
+                            continue
+                        payload = line[len("data:") :].strip()
+                        if payload == "[DONE]":

+                        first_token_seen.set()

+                first_token_seen.set()

+        stream_thread.start()
+        self.assertTrue(
+            first_token_seen.wait(timeout=180), "decode stream never started"
+        )
+        self.assertIsNone(
+            stream_state["error"], f"stream failed: {stream_state['error']}"
+        )

+        # Inject long prompts while the stream is decoding: running_batch and
+        # split_prefill_batch are now concurrently non-empty.
+        with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(len(NEEDLE_CODES)) as pool:

+                pool.submit(self._generate, _needle_prompt(code), 32)
+                for code in NEEDLE_CODES

+            # (iii) deadlock detection
+            self.assertFalse(
+                not_done, "long-prompt requests timed out (possible deadlock)"
+            )

+        self.assertIsNone(
+            stream_state["error"], f"stream failed: {stream_state['error']}"
+        )
+

+        for code, future in zip(NEEDLE_CODES, futures):
+            self.assertIn(

+                future.result(),

+        # the early tokens are decoded while the long prompts are still
+        # prefilling on the other SM partition.
+        prefix_len = 200

+            baseline_text[:prefix_len],
+            stream_state["text"][:prefix_len],

+        )

+        # batch during the storm; the server must still be healthy.
+        after_text = self._generate("The capital of France is", 32)
+        self.assertIn("Paris", after_text)

+combined. Intermediate slices preserve batch-owned mHC/carry state; only the last
+slice computes logits. A prefill with no decode work executes its remaining layers
+in one call. With decode work, the slice budget divides by the maximum prefill
+token count across attention DP ranks, matching the `layer_split` path of

+        value = self.index + 1
+        return hidden_states + value, value, value + 10, value + 20

+        next_combined,

+        positions,
+        **kwargs,

+        self.calls.append(
+            (prev_pre, combined_attn, normalized_attn, input_ids, positions)

+        value = self.index + 1
+        hidden = hidden_states + value
+        if combined_attn is not None:

+        if normalized_attn is not None:
